domain: Web Analytics and User Tracking Cookies Management
scenario:
An international chemical manufacturing company, Elix Polymers, is implementing an advanced Web Analytics and User Tracking Management System to monitor and optimize their website traffic and user engagement. The system is designed to handle various analytics tools like Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica, which use cookies to collect detailed visitor data. The platform should enable the company to manage cookies effectively, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA.

The system must provide comprehensive insights into user behavior, session durations, source attribution, and campaign performance. It should support detailed reporting on user identifiers, session tracking, and browser preferences without compromising user privacy. The platform must also allow the company to configure cookie lifetimes, manage consent agreements, and customize analytics settings to cater to different regions and privacy laws.

Furthermore, the system should offer advanced data visualization tools for marketing and product teams to analyze trends, measure campaign effectiveness, and derive actionable insights. Integrations with third-party tools and scalable infrastructure are essential for handling increasing data volumes as the company's digital presence grows.
